reading.body:
Kountoupes Denham Carr & Reid filed 89 AI lobbying reports, and its largest AI clients are Mozilla and Pinterest at 14 filings each.

The client list is not dominated by AI model developers. It is dominated by consumer internet platforms, a health insurance trade group, a retail trade group, a retailer, an imaging coalition, and an electrical manufacturers association. Anthropic appears with 4 filings, Intel with 7. The AI policy fight this firm works on runs through retail, health, and manufacturing interests as much as through frontier labs.

The work is concentrated in a small number of people. Five lobbyists, David Peluso, Mj Kenny, Adam Hechavarria, Lisa Kountoupes, and Lori Denham, are each named on 46 or more of the firm's AI filings. That concentration matters because lobbying capacity is a labor constraint, not a capital one, and a firm's reach on AI is bounded by how many of its people carry the issue.

The data covers filings and named bills only. It does not record what position the firm argued, what any client asked for, or whether the lobbying changed anything. One bill, HR 7757, is named in filings from 2025 or later, so the legislative record here is thin. Nothing in this data speaks to data centers, power, or compute.

summary: KOUNTOUPES DENHAM CARR & REID, LLC filed 89 Lobbying Disclosure Act reports on AI held by this site. Its clients, the lobbyists named on those filings and the AI bills they name are below. LDA registrant id 320918.
